summary: Frontend-only testing of VWAP Flip Mini Chart component in ChartPanel. All 8 required test cases PASS. Component renders correctly with correct colors, labels, SVG elements, and dimming logic.

issues: On daily (1D) timeframe with multi-year historical data (e.g. RELIANCE 2015-2026), cumulative session VWAP = 121.2 vs current price = 1282.2 → distance = +958.17%. This is technically correct per implementation spec but produces misleading distance % on long-horizon daily charts. VWAP is more meaningful on intraday timeframes (5M, 15M, 1H). Consider capping displayed distance or adding a tooltip note when distance > 100%.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Consider adding visual warning or capping distance % display when using daily timeframe where cumulative VWAP diverges massively from current price. Not a bug, just a UX enhancement.
critical_code_review_comments: VWAP calculation uses ALL bars (cumulative from first bar): on 1D timeframe data spanning years, VWAP becomes a long-run average (not session VWAP). The distance % will be enormous (e.g. +958%). This is technically correct per spec but consider limiting to intraday timeframes or recent N bars for meaningful VWAP-based trading signals.
The component correctly returns null when bars.length < 5 — guards are in place.

px(1) used in crossing interpolation (line 64: `px(1) * Math.abs(prev - vwap)`) appears to be a minor formula issue — should use `(px(i) - px(i-1))` instead of `px(1)` for general spacing, though for uniform bar spacing px(1) is equivalent to bar width, so this works correctly.
